brief: Classifies a point by the majority label of its k nearest training examples, with no training step and a full explanation.
detail: The purest explainable classifier: nothing is fitted, and Why lists the neighbours that voted with their distances. The search is exact by default and runs in the engine; the resident index rebuilds when examples have been added through TrainingSetQ. Approximate search is an opt-in switch because the library cannot know how many queries will follow, and because it may change an answer; AgreementWithExact measures the cost on your own queries. Features are compared by Euclidean distance, so scale them first when their units differ.
